name: Dunkinn
address: 8801 Frontage Road South, Bay 4, Behind The Other One, Sprawl Ring 6
about: Dunkinn is a beverage-and-glazed-matter dispensary operating on a continuous morning. Donuts are classified by structural load before dispatch. You are already enrolled in the rewards program and have been since first contact.
announcement: MORNING IS NOW CONTINUOUS. Breakfast classification is available 24 hours and is not related to the position of the sun.

reviews.name: Dwayne R.
reviews.text: Ordered a Municipal pour at 4am and it arrived in a vessel I could not lift alone. The Slinger helped. He also could not lift it alone.

reviews.name: Priya N.
reviews.text: The glaze arrived adjacent to the donut, which the app had warned me about in writing. I have no complaint, only an observation.

reviews.name: Marcus T.
reviews.text: I declined the sprinkles and was charged for declining the sprinkles. Everything was disclosed. Everything was delicious.

reviews.name: Lorna V.
reviews.text: Requested my enrollment records and received a laminated card with a date on it from before I was born. The coffee was hot.

reviews.name: Bev S.
reviews.text: Two hundred spheres on a sheet pan that I am contractually required to return. I will not be returning it. Five stars.

menu.name: Donuts By Structural Class
menu.blurb: Every unit is rated for load, sag, and glaze adhesion at the moment of dispatch.

items.name: Class IV Load-Bearing Glazed
items.desc: The reference donut against which all other donuts in this facility are measured. Certified to support the weight of a second donut for the duration of a normal delivery.
items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: a leaning tower of eleven glazed yeast donuts stacked into a single load-bearing column, thick translucent glaze sheeting down the outside in ribbons and pooling on the counter below, the bottom donut visibly compressed and squeezing outward under the mass above it, sugar crackle glinting across every surface. Setting: a bright white bakery case shelf with a glossy orange counter, pink and orange sprinkles scattered across the surface. Lighting: flat bright high-key lighting, no moody shadows, candy-saturated pinks and oranges, glossy sugar sheen, cheerful and jittery. Camera: 85mm three-quarter hero angle, shallow depth of field, high contrast. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: extreme macro of the crown of a magenta-frosted donut, the frosting cratered and wet-looking and slumping heavily over one side, thousands of pink, orange and white sprinkles packed edge to edge across it and spilling off the rim in a small avalanche onto the counter, individual sugar crystals razor sharp, a bead of frosting hanging mid-drip. Setting: a bright white bakery case shelf with a glossy orange counter, pink and orange sprinkles scattered across the surface. Lighting: flat bright high-key lighting, no moody shadows, candy-saturated pinks and oranges, glossy sugar sheen, cheerful and jittery. Camera: 100mm macro, extremely shallow depth of field, a narrow slice of focus. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

menu.name: The Panic Line
menu.blurb: Coffee dispensed at the velocity of your morning. Volume tiers escalate to municipal scale.

items.name: The Original Iced, Personal Through Watershed
items.desc: Our founding beverage, poured over displaced ice in a vessel sized to your household, your block, or your water district. Watershed pours are scheduled rather than dispensed.
items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: an enormous clear cup of iced coffee photographed straight down into the vessel, cream plunging through the dark coffee in thick curling ribbons that have not yet merged, ice cubes packed so tightly they press up past the rim, a slow whirlpool still turning at the center, condensation beading heavily and running over the lip onto the counter. Setting: a bright white bakery case shelf with a glossy orange counter, pink and orange sprinkles scattered across the surface. Lighting: flat bright high-key lighting, no moody shadows, candy-saturated pinks and oranges, glossy sugar sheen, cheerful and jittery. Camera: 50mm directly overhead, looking down into the cup, shallow depth of field. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

Harsh direct on-camera flash, hot blown-out hotspot on the cheese, hard black shadow thrown behind the sandwich. Framed slightly crooked and off-centre with the paper bag cut off at the right edge, cluttered background of a donut shop back counter: a coffee urn, a napkin dispenser, a stack of lids and a scratched laminate work surface. Framed crooked and shot from too close, the box cut off at the left edge, sitting on a scratched laminate counter with sugar crumbs, a napkin dispenser and a stack of paper bags cluttering the background.
